about: Competitors the weekly competitor watch follows on top of the core list in scripts/agent_search.py. The monthly competitor scout searches the web for NEW golf price-comparison sites, deal sites, used-club valuers, golf society apps and golf games, and proposes additions here on a branch for John to merge. status: "watch" (followed every week), "noted" (seen, not worth weekly tracking yet) or "dropped" (closed or no longer relevant). Never copy a competitor's wording.
